recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further core source work is recommended unless a future FHIRPath type-system decision changes the interpretation of as(uri) for canonical/url subtypes.
issue_request: FHIR-43690 was an Applied FHIR-I change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification for R6, asking to fix the DomainResource dom-3 invariant because the old FHIRPath expression duplicated the canonical check, omitted uri/url checks in the contained-resource back-reference half, and was inefficient.
initial_application: The issue was applied by git commit 86ddd389b9c7690e89ddc061f23f3e6fa09333b6, which changed source/domainresource/structuredefinition-DomainResource.xml from the duplicated ofType(canonical) expression to the approved select(reference | as(uri)) and reference='#' | as(uri)='#' expression.
additional_context: DomainResource is an active build artifact in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-I minutes on 2024-12-16 recorded concern that the proposed expression still needed to cover the contained resource referring to the containing resource, the linked Zulip review concluded canonical and url are subtypes of uri, and FHIR-I minutes on 2025-01-06 recorded the final persuasive vote. The current combined branch source contains the approved expression.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current DomainResource source already implements the final approved expression, including the simplified uri subtype handling and the contained-resource reference-to-container test.
